stories.title: Украинский омбудсмен с начала 2026 года получил почти 6 тыс. жалоб на ТЦК

en.title: Ukrainian ombudsman received almost 6,000 complaints about TCC since start of 2026
en.summary: Ukraine's ombudsman has received nearly 6,000 complaints regarding the Territorial Defense Commission since the beginning of 2026, according to Dmytro Lubinets, matching the total received throughout all of 2025.

stories.title: Студент РГГУ получил 19 лет лишения свободы за подготовку теракта в мечети

en.title: RSUH student sentenced to 19 years imprisonment for preparing mosque attack
en.summary: A 19-year-old Russian State University for the Humanities student was convicted of preparing a terrorist attack on a mosque and participating in terrorist organization activities. The Western District Military Court sentenced him to 19 years on October 6.

stories.title: Основательнице "Медузы" Тимченко оставили в силе пятилетний заочный срок

en.title: Meduza founder Timchenko's five-year in absentia sentence upheld
en.summary: A court upheld a five-year in absentia prison sentence against Meduza founder Timchenko, who is accused of conducting activities of an undesirable organization.

stories.title: ВЦИОМ: 80% опрошенных россиян считают Путина одним из самых влиятельных лидеров мира

en.title: VCIOM: 80% of surveyed Russians consider Putin one of world's most influential leaders
en.summary: An opinion poll found that 80 percent of Russian respondents view President Vladimir Putin as one of the world's most influential leaders, while 17 percent disagree with this assessment.

stories.title: В России могут разрешить регистрировать бизнес по адресу электронной почты

en.title: Russia may allow business registration using email address
en.summary: Russian authorities are considering a proposal to permit business registration through email addresses instead of requiring physical addresses for official corporate communications.

stories.title: Отец 13 детей и ребенок погибли в российском регионе при атаке ВСУ

en.title: Father of 13 children and child killed in Russian region during Ukrainian attack
en.summary: A man with 13 children and a child died in a Russian region as a result of an attack attributed to Ukrainian forces.

en.title: Nationalist Bokov* sentenced to 19 years for preparing mosque attack
en.summary: A nationalist individual identified as Bokov received a 19-year prison sentence for preparing a terrorist attack at a mosque.

stories.title: В России предложили разрешить регистрировать бизнес через электронную почту

en.title: Russia proposes allowing business registration via email
en.summary: Russian government officials indicated that current legislation requires legal entities to use physical addresses for official communications, but a proposal suggests allowing email-based registration instead.

stories.title: Генконсульство РФ подтвердило гибель российского парапланериста в Турции

en.title: Russian Consulate General confirms death of Russian paraglider in Turkey
en.summary: The Russian diplomatic mission confirmed the death of a Russian paraglider in Turkey and stated it is assisting with documentation for repatriating the body to Russia.

stories.title: Российский турист разбился в Турции во время полета на параплане

en.title: Russian tourist dies in Turkey during paragliding flight
en.summary: Russian citizen Alexander Kishemet died while paragliding near the Turkish city of Fethiye after pushing off from a cliff edge and falling.

en.summary: A Russian poll found that eighty percent of respondents view the president as a politician of global significance.

stories.title: Лидер фракции «Новых людей» в петербургском парламенте вышел из партии

en.title: Leader of New People faction in St. Petersburg parliament left the party
en.summary: Dmitry Pavlov, who led the New People faction in the St. Petersburg Legislative Assembly since 2021, has resigned from the party. He stated he will have greater credibility with voters as an independent deputy.

en.title: CSKA President Andrey Vatutin commented on the results of Euroleague and NBA negotiations
en.summary: Negotiations between the NBA and Euroleague regarding a new continental basketball tournament remain ongoing without a final agreement. CSKA Moscow president Andrey Vatutin provided updates on the discussions.

en.summary: CSKA Moscow representatives plan to meet with Euroleague General Director Chús Bueno to discuss steps for the team's return to the continent's premier basketball tournament. Club president Andrey Vatutin disclosed the upcoming discussions.
